title: Monoceros versions before 0.30 for Perl allow a request declaring a large Content-Length to kill a… (CVE-2026-115864)
description: Monoceros versions before 0.30 for Perl contain a vulnerability where a remote attacker can send a request with a large Content-Length header to exhaust memory and kill a worker process. This occurs because the request body is read in a loop that attempts to allocate a buffer equal to the declared Content-Length before any data arrives, causing an uncatchable out-of-memory error and worker termination.
